docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $160.85 FILED BY CARUSO, LORENZO AS TO DEFENDANT JUPITER PRINTING ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAR-10-2005 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT JUPITER PRINTING

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF CARUSO, LORENZO RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT JUPITER PRINTING $160.85 PRINCIPAL, $22.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $182.85, CONCURRENTLY WITH THE PAYMENT OF THIS JUDGMENT PLAINTIFF SHALL MAKE THE ENVELOPES WITH INKSPOTS AVAILABLE FOR RETURN TO DEFENDANT. DEFENDANT FAILED TO APPEAR. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
